thread:
ana-docs: Heads-up: the localization docs page has two conflicting recommendations about endpoint redirects and SDK header usage. Which is the source of truth? /cc @sam-eng @liam-legal

sam-eng: I put a note in the spec: prefer `x-redwood-region` header for SDKs, fallback to query param for legacy clients. Example snippet needed for Node + curl.

miles-ux: Thanks. Can we avoid calling it 'legacy' in UI? maybe 'compat' or show example with both?

kai-sdk: I can add a PR with a short Node snippet. Proposed code:

```js
const r = await client.generate({model:'redwood-mini', input});
// add header for region
client.headers['x-redwood-region'] = 'eu-west-1';
```

Is that ok?

sam-eng: looks fine; also need to show how gateway does geo-traffic routing + residency note: 'Data processed in selected region unless explicitly routed'

liam-legal: Let's use: 'Data residency: requests with a region header are processed in the specified region; logs and metadata may be stored in control-plane region per contract.' Need approval from infra.

ana-docs: Can you post exact one-line legal wording @liam-legal? We'll add to the top of the page and the SDK snippet caption.

liam-legal: Suggested short line: 'Selecting a region routes inference to that region's compute; control-plane metadata (billing, metrics) may be stored in the Redwood control plane subject to your residency contract.'

sam-eng: :+1: will add fallback note. Also, add a short migration guide: how to swap query-param to header. Example CLI: `curl -H 'x-redwood-region: eu' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'`

deploy-bot: docs-bot: branch `docs/geo-snippet-refactor` deployed preview at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/geo-routing (build 1123) :rocket:

ana-docs: Great — I'll draft the PR and ping for review. Targeting small copy + Node snippet + curl. @miles-ux can you quick-check the UI wording?

miles-ux: On it, will send micro-suggestion in PR. :eyes:
